pave.path.description: Path to the pavels language server executable. If empty, pavels is resolved from PATH. Supports ${userHome}, ${workspaceFolder}, and ${env:VAR_NAME}.

pave.args.description: List of args for pave: "name=path" module search roots, followed by a '--' element, followed by clang args.

pave.cmakeArgsVariable.description: Name of a CMake cache variable containing a combined list of pave args, in the same format as pave.args. When set and found in the CMake build directory's CMakeCache.txt, it takes precedence over pave.args.

pave.cmakeBuildDirectory.description: Path of the CMake build directory containing CMakeCache.txt, used to resolve pave.cmakeArgsVariable. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder. Supports ${userHome}, ${workspaceFolder}, and ${env:VAR_NAME}.
